FOR RESEARCHERS AND PRESS
  Free data, code and method.
  Everything behind the public studies is free to use, with a link. No registration.
  Email a research or press questionIf your email app doesn’t open, write to donttrade.research@gmail.com with the subject “Press: [publication]”.Copy address

  Disposition-effect replication (6 Oct 2026)Insider-buying study, a negative result (11 Oct 2026)Portfolio-driven disposition effect: the headline did not survive a stricter test (corrected 17 Oct 2026)Volatility-scaled momentum, a pre-registered negative result (16 Oct 2026)Swing-trading strategies under hashed pre-registration, a negative result (16 Oct 2026)Fifty trading strategies across four styles, a combined negative result (17 Oct 2026)
  Licences and citing
  Write-ups and charts CC BY-NC 4.0; study code MIT; the partner script from v2: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0, free for research; v1 stays MIT. Each study page has a “Cite this study” block.
  Corrections
  Found an error? Email with the subject “Correction”. Verified errors are corrected within 30 days and logged permanently. Corrections →
  Press
  Email with “Press” in the subject: donttrade.research@gmail.com. Reply within 1 business day; interviews by email only. We don’t comment on individual firms.
